import Analysis.Convex.StrictConcave
import Real.Log
import Real.Sqrt

open Real

theorem lg_target : StrictConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) fun x => √x := by
  have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => √x) 0 := by
    rw [differentiableAt_zero_sqrt]
    exact differentiableAt_zero_sqrt
    
  have h2 : ∀ x > 0, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => √x) x := by
    intro x
    apply differentiableAt_sqrt
    
  have h3 : ∀ x > 0, (differentialAction (fun x => √x) x).deriv = 1 / (2 * √x) := by
    intro x
    rw [deriv_sqrt]
    
  have h4 : ∀ x > 0, (differentialAction (fun x => √x) x).deriv_deriv = -1 / (4 * x^(3/2)) := by
    intro x
    rw [deriv_deriv_sqrt]
    
  have h5 : ∀ x > 0, 0 < -1 / (4 * x^(3/2)) := by
    intro x
    have h6 : x > 0 := by assumption
    have h7 : x^(3/2) > 0 := by
      rw [pow_pos_iff]
      exact h6
    have h8 : 4 * x^(3/2) > 0 := by
      rw [mul_pos]
      exact (zero_lt_four : 0 < 4) ∧ h7
    have h9 : 0 < -1 / (4 * x^(3/2)) :=
      by
        rw [neg_div_eq_neg_div]
        exact neg_pos_one_div_pos h8
    exact h9
    
  exact StrictConcaveOn.Icc_Union_Ioi (Set.Icc 0 0) (Set.Ioi 0) (fun x => √x) h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
